correctness.rationale: The exact S-module decomposition follows from the derivatives of F and (U,V)-degree truncation, with an injective 2-column matrix. Standard Hankel maximal minors give a rational normal curve of codimension m-1 >=2; the Auslander--Buchsbaum local-depth argument excludes all nonzero S-associated primes, proving primaryness and saturation. The same free presentation gives the exact Hilbert series, nilpotent multiplicity, depth m, and Cohen--Macaulay failure precisely along the rank-jump curve. Exact finite-field quotient dimensions for m=3,4,5 at degrees m through m+3 in two primes were checked (VERIFY_OK 27). Finite checks are not the all-m proof.
